desc: Tackle box spirit: small violet tackle box with a gold latch, tiny legs. Face: a single round cyclops eye peeking from the open lid, a thin gold-lined slit. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
